notes: מִן with a resumptive שָׁם is split at 2KI.17.27 (*from* / *thence*) and was fused here as *from among*. The fusion does not survive rule 30's own subtraction test: dropping *among* leaves מִן holding *from*, which is the word this chapter spends on that preposition in eleven other units, so a particular morpheme owns a part of the rendering and rule 2 splits. The reading is unstable in either direction besides — if *among* carries שָׁם's locative sense then שָׁם owns it and the pair splits, and if it does not, rule 30 forbids absorbing שָׁם into a rendering whose sense it has no part in. The split is taken, with *among* as what the ASV spends on the resumptive locative, exactly as rule 32 gives a directive he whatever word the ASV writes for the direction. Nothing else in the verse changes.
